As we can see, you have made your booking through Airbnb, and your check-in date is tomorrow, 15 July.

Please note that our standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Your check-in instructions and all the necessary details will be provided between 2:00 PM and 3:00 PM on your arrival day.

Thank you, and we look forward to welcoming you!
